Title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup
FAQ: How do I set up two-factor authentication?

Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your account. To enable 2FA, go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and click Enable. We support authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Authy) and SMS verification. Authenticator apps are recommended over SMS for stronger security. After enabling 2FA, you will be prompted for a verification code at each login.
--- End Document 1 ---

final_answer:
Multi-factor authentication is a security layer that requires users to provide two or more forms of authentication before accessing their accounts. This can include something they know, like a password, and something they have, like a smartphone or a physical token. Multi-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security to protect against unauthorized access. The use of multi-factor authentication is becoming increasingly common as cybersecurity threats continue to evolve.
